services.name: Educational Tour
services.desc: We create an interactive and immersive educational experience that will stay with the students long after the tour has ended. Rates Student - $8 Adult - $13 Duration 1.5 hours About Our 1.5 hour Group Educational Cruise is a private experience geared towards homeschool groups, school field trips, camp field trips, and educational organizations for students K-12 (ages 5+). Students and chaperones will be on the boat for the entire 1.5 hours, where we will scout for wildlife, collect data on water samples, and discuss the local ecosystem and ways to protect our waterways! quotes.author: Nick M.
quotes.text: Kevin really made the tour fun while also being very informative. Good selection of beer and wine on board and the ride was smooth. It was a really good time and well worth the money. On top of that we were thrilled to hear that the company also gives free tours to schools which we support 100%. Great company, great tour, great time.

quotes.author: canfieldle
quotes.text: The sunset cruise was a lot of fun while also informative. Kevin was our tour guide and he was great...he and the captain, Mike, gave us the perfect introduction to St. Augustine! I would highly recommend this tour. Oh, and we saw dolphins and a stingray jumped out of the water right next to our boat! That was such a thrill!

quotes.author: Kat_ontherun
quotes.text: Personable staff, beautiful scenery, great tour! We really enjoyed ourselves - having a drink, listening to the crew talk about St A, snapping pics as the sun slowly set over the historic downtown. Can’t believe we hadn’t done this before & will definitely take one of their other tours next time we’re in town.

quotes.author: Tim B.
quotes.text: The Sunset Cruise in St. Augustine was great! The boat ride was relaxing and informative. Kevin, the co-pilot / narrator was witty and knowledgeable. Made the trip light and fun. The scenery was beautiful and included sightings of Dolphins,Terns & Pelicans. Sunset was nice too.
